correctness.rationale: For any topology omega is monotone, closed-valued and omega^2<=omega. If a surjective inverse-image representation exists, this forces R^2<=R; any loop forces an omega-perfect closed set and obstructs scatteredness. The explicit cluster-wise countable poset is antisymmetric and transitive, and its principal-upset intersection with saturated valuations is either singleton/finite or infinite precisely when the source relation has a successor in the valuation. Countable scatteredness follows from absence of infinite ascending chains and the reciprocal equivalence for Alexandroff posets. Modal formula preservation is by structural induction; disjoint union of finite countermodels gives the one-space logics and finite carriers have zero omega. Reconstructed proof covers isolated/empty/recurrent clusters; standalone checker exhausts 4180 transitive relations and 779484 finite identities (not an infinite proof).

value.rationale: The exact finite-source representability boundary identifies transitivity as necessary and sufficient and shows precisely how scatteredness adds irreflexivity; this is a natural structural classification of complex modal algebras for a new topological modality, not a renamed textbook interior result. The constructive saturated valuation embedding and single countable T0 Alexandrov K4/GL models sharpen the 2026 class-based completeness theorem; the aleph0 lower bound is attained and supplies a natural cardinal optimum. The result provides reusable semantic models and a clean bridge between order structures and provability logic.
